messages:
marco: Heads-up — planning a small router header-split for the EU change window tonight (23:00 UTC). Need console + runtime readiness before we cut traffic.

jess: Acknowledged. Which runtime variant are we routing to? the q2-compat build?

marco: Yes, runtime:v2.1-compat (quantized). Router will do a soft-split 10% -> 100% over 15m. Console needs the new schema flag enabled, API team must pin v2.1 for the window.

deploy-bot: deploy request received for runtime:v2.1-compat to eu-pool. Estimated rollout start 2026-03-22T23:00:00Z. Please confirm gates: console-flag=true, api-pin=v2.1, router-health>=95%.

jess: I can flip console-flag once runtime is up in staging and smoke passes. Will run smoke: `curl -H "X-Env: staging" https://console-staging.internal/health` and post results.

cami: API can pin route to v2.1 for the window. I need confirmation on fallback behavior — if runtime reports 5xx, router should auto-fallback to v2.0. Is that set?

marco: Yes fallback is configured. Router TTLs at 30s. Fallback threshold = 3% 5xx over 1m. We'll keep an emergency unpin command ready.

sre-oncall: I'll watch telemetry during the ramp. Can we add an alert for request_latency > 300ms p50 on runtime:v2.1? If we see that, hold the rollout.

jess: Smoke result: `OK` for console schema and feature-flag. samples: `{"schema":"v2","routes":12}`. Posting logs: https://logs.internal/sha/abcd1234

deploy-bot: Gate update: console-flag=true, api-pin=v2.1, runtime staging smoke=pass. Proceeding to scheduled push to eu-pool at 23:00 UTC.

marco: Final checklist: (1) router split policy -> 10%/30s increments, (2) runtime KV cache primed, (3) canary tester running against console+api. If any gate trips, we do emergency unpin and route back to v2.0.

cami: Canary started. First 200 requests look fine. No regressions in structured output.

sre-oncall: Monitoring looks good so far. Added alert for p50 latency > 300ms and error rate > 2%.

(just before rollout) jess: quick note — release-notes: `router: header-split; runtime: v2.1-compat (quantized); console: schema v2`. Pushing to #release-notes after cut.

deploy-bot: Rollout started at 2026-03-22T23:00:05Z. Step 1 -> 10% traffic.

marco: Observing metrics — small uptick in p95 but within tolerance. Holding for 2m.

(2m later) deploy-bot: Step 2 -> 30% traffic.

sre-oncall: No error increase. Latency stable. Continue.

deploy-bot: Step 3 -> 60% traffic.

cami: Seeing one trace with truncated kv-cache response, filing ticket INC-4721. Not blocking but watch closely.

marco: Good catch. If that repeats, we roll back. For now continue to 100%.

deploy-bot: Final step -> 100% traffic at 2026-03-22T23:12:40Z. Rollout complete.

jess: Release notes posted: https://releases.internal/notes/20260322-router-split

sre-oncall: Will keep 60m watch. If any alert fires, I'll ping @marco and trigger emergency-unpin. :eyes:

marco: Thanks everyone. Postmortem if we see any degradation; otherwise we'll archive this as standard change.
